# Splats to Points

Turns splat centres and base colours into a point cloud.

`lfs.splats_to_points` · Conversion

## How to use

Use to export centres or process your scene as points.  
Splat size, opacity and camera-dependent colour are not kept.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
